Re: Arrival Of The Queen Of Sheba

Well done for the score, but odd, isn’t it, that Handel’s main association with Ireland is “Messiah”, which premiered in Dublin in 1742, but “Solomon”, from which “The Arrival of the Queen of Sheba” originates, premiered in London in 1749? (Or did you realise it was Handel - “in the public domain”) Anyway, a good tune, thanks George Frederic!

Re: The Arrival Of The Queen Of Sheba

@JackB,

Your version has some crooked measures in it. As if there are either missing notes or notes with the wrong values (eighth notes that should be quarter or longer to fill the measure). Arg! This is super fun to play through but then…I fall into the hole. Anybody have corrections? It is clear to me that they are not meant to be different meters where they occur. For example, the bars with sixteenth notes are 5 beats, as is the one bar with the triplet.
